newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks move in line after hours.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks move in line after hours.

text.p: After-hours trading suffered from the Monday doldrums, as most stocks stayed in line with their closing prices following a choppy session on Wall Street.
Earnings from National Patent Development Corp, Sun International Hotels Ltd, OMI Corp and from other companies reporting after the bell failed to inspire much activity.
One dealer noted movement in Informix shares, but said the moves stayed at the 10-1/2 close, which was off 1/8 on the day.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had volume of 13,600, compared with 68,300 on Friday, and session two had volume of 4.1 million, compared with 2.0 million.
